briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities as compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month while governments accelerated export controls on advanced chips. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing in the US and China. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world exploit reports.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with improved long-horizon reasoning; Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus targeting agentic workflows. Google launched Gemini 3 Ultra while xAI and DeepSeek announced competitive 1.2T parameter systems.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began volume production of 1.6nm AI accelerators; Microsoft and CoreWeave announced 200k H100-equivalent cluster expansions. Saudi Arabia committed $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first 10T-parameter model cross the autonomy threshold before regulatory frameworks can constrain deployment?
